text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Spring Fan Thanksgiving Festival. True 
to its name, a great number of fans visit 
the academy on this day, however...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The Fan Thanksgiving Festival... it is 
truly wonderful. As a saint, I dearly 
wished to convey the revelations of Heaven 
to everyone, but...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Regrettably, we were unable to rent a 
stage for that...
choice_data_list:
I'm sure a lot of people would want to use 
it, though...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes...—However! A saint has other duties 
as well!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It is to ensure as many people as possible 
enjoy this day! To fill this land with 
overflowing smiles!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fans and Umamusume alike. I want this Fan 
Thanksgiving to be something everyone can 
enjoy...!
choice_data_list:
If that's the case... then what I must do 
as a saintess is...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Normally, I would be offering a 
helping hand to those who are lost, 
purifying spirits, settling disputes... 
and things like that, but..."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
A lost child, you say?! That's a major 
incident...! What do they look like?! This 
officer will find them immediately!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Sort your trash properly!! If you don't 
know how, I'll teach you! Ah! Hey you two! 
No fighting!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It seems there are plenty of hands 
available. Of course, if something happens 
right in front of me, I won't just ignore 
it, but...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
If I were to actively seek out 
disturbances and act, I might end up 
robbing others of their roles. That would 
weigh heavily on my heart...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... What can I do to help everyone have 
an even more blissful time...!
choice_data_list: Maybe even the little things matter.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A minor detail... you say? What on earth 
could it be...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I've prepared delicious fried chicken for 
all the fans! It's piping hot and fresh 
out of the fryer~!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
We've got fresh vegetables grown right at 
the academy, too~ You can use them in all 
kinds of dishes~

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Ah. Oh no, Acute-san! We're almost 
completely out of vegetables. Everyone's 
saying the shape and color are beautiful, 
so they're super popular!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, that makes me so happy. Just 
wait right there, dear, I'll go fetch some 
more right away—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Desire-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I will go fetch it. There's a huge crowd 
of fans lined up, so please, do not leave 
this spot!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~! The fried chicken is so good~!! I'm 
gonna get seconds!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
These carrots look gorgeous~! I feel like 
I could just bite right into one...! The 
other veggies look delicious too, though~!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Everyone looks so happy. Thanks to 
Desire-chan, without keeping any customers 
waiting—...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Desire-chan? Where'd she go... I 
haven't even properly thanked her yet!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, yikes! A piece rolled away. Where is 
it... ugh, it's so tiny, now I've totally 
lost track of it, seriously...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"A-Are you alright? Um... should I help 
look for it too?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm good. But sorry, hold up a sec... 
These are just spares, but I'd hate for 
them to get stepped on... I promise I'll 
make your nails super cute~."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Leave this to me, Jordan-san! Please grant 
the holy color that banishes evil unto the 
fan's fingertips!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? Desire-chan??

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely find the part you 
dropped. ...After all, I am a saint!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why are you being so desperate about 
it...? I mean, I appreciate it, but...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Pay it no mind! —Now, O holy light, please 
answer my prayer... and guide me to the 
fragment that has fallen to the earth...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! Jordan-san, ever since 
I saw you on TV, I've always thought your 
nails were so cute. I'm super happy. Total 
bliss~♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Fufun~♪ Even if I say so myself, this 
turned out amazing.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah. I mean, thanks to Desire-chan, no one 
had to wait... wait, huh? Heyyy, 
Desire-chaaan~?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, welcome! Care to try a game of 
chicken with a voice-controlled RC car~?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The rules are simple. Just say 'Stop!' 
right on the edge of the platform before 
you fall off.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Let's see who can push closer to the 
edge... Time for a thrilling showdown.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Win and you get a prize, but if you 
lose... you get the picture, right? Better 
get ready to scream."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh. With this cutting-edge automated 
acupressure foot massager, prepare for a 
terror of—... Huh? Wait, it's not working? 
For real?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa. What is it, Desire...? Don't tell me 
you can fix it?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No. But... I, Saint Red Desire, shall 
become your foot reflexology massager!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... Haha. I-It hurt, but I 
somehow feel refreshed! Even though I 
lost, I feel pretty good, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, nice going, Desire-chan. Looks like 
the last customer was plenty satisfied, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Normally I'd want them to feel frustrated 
after losing, but, well... I guess that 
just shows how good Desire's skills really 
were.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hey, Desire...—Huh? Where'd she go?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Whew. I really must rest for a little 
while.
choice_data_list: Because you worked so hard, after all.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes. ...It has been very fulfilling 
indeed.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of the fans, I will become 
the strength of the Uma Musume who devote 
their love to them.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Even though it was just a small favor... 
what I gained from it was huge.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Thank you so much for guiding me 
so wonderfully! I feel so deeply 
fulfilled.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I was able to see the 
smiles of the fans and the other 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing her assistance and seeing 
the smiles and relieved expressions of the 
fans and Umamusume, Red Desire promptly 
took her leave.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because to see as many smiles as 
possible, no amount of time was ever 
enough.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I didn't do it because I wanted 
thanks... I just wanted to see people 
smile.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah. May blessings rain down from the 
heavens...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Trainer. If I hadn't been 
mindful, I might have brushed it off as 
trivial and overlooked someone in need.
choice_data_list: It's really nothing to thank me for...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No, please let me say it. Because this is 
an expression of my gratitude to you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but truly... It was a wonderful 
Thanksgiving Festival, brimming with 
smiles.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, found you! Desire-chaaan! Thanks for 
earlier~!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I brought loooots of rice ball-sans and 
crunchy snack-sans~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there you are! Lemme at least thank 
you a little. I brought nail stickers, so 
I'm gonna make your nails super cute!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo, reflexology master, where are 
ya~? ...Ah, there you are. Thanks for 
earlier. Your hands and arms must be beat, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Next, we'll give you a massage. Consider 
it our thanks. It was pretty fun, after 
all."
choice_data_list: Looks like everyone came looking for you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
E-Everyone... Oh, heavens, what is this? 
Did you go through all this trouble... 
just for me...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Something like this... to happen. 
...T-Thank you so much! I'm just so 
happy...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Thanks to you, I was able to spend 
the day without bringing shame upon the 
Saintess.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's kindness... It feels like your 
love is being returned to me!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...A heart of gratitude is something that 
comes full circle, doesn't it? May this 
wonderful Fan Appreciation Festival... be 
blessed with brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: And... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much for keeping me company 
all day today."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to express my heartfelt 
gratitude. Fufu.
